messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up 4e2 I've pushed a draft called 'Compassionate Travel-Disruption Leave' to the handbook. Focused on guidance for caregivers stranded by cancellations and a clearer retro-pay process. Please scan for anything missing.

Diego (Eng Manager): Thanks. Two quick checks: retro-pay window? And how do managers capture employee statements for verification?

Maya (People Ops): Retro-pay: eligible up to 14 days from incident, with manager + People Ops approval. For documentation we accept email threads, flight disruption notices, or a short signed statement. Added examples in the draft.

Lina (HR-Intl): Note: several EU jurisdictions require notification timelines for leave. I added an "International Notes" appendix with per-country links and a short template for managers to use. Link: https://notion.redwood/handbook/compassionate-travel-leave

Priya (Hiring Ops): For rollout are we doing manager-level acknowledgements or team-level? I can create a manager ack flow and batch-send. Prefer manager-level for accountability.

Maya (People Ops): Manager-level please. Two waves: wave A = managers with 6+ directs, wave B = rest. Target completion: 7 business days. Reminder schedule: day 0, day 2, day 5. If ack rate < 50% at day 5, we escalate to org leads.

Priya (Hiring Ops): Ill export managers and generate per-manager links. Can param manager_id and team_size in the URL so the ack page shows their directs. Will coordinate with DevEx for the short tokenized link.

Diego (Eng Manager): Can the ack be auto-logged in People Ops so we don't have to manually update spreadsheets?

Priya (Hiring Ops): Yes, push to the People Ops tracking sheet via our internal webhook. Ill attach CSV to the People Ops drive and set the webhook when I run the job.

handbook-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Handbook: Compassionate Travel-Disruption Leave  Manager ack due in 7d"  sending wave A in 10 minutes.

Maya (People Ops): Also proposing a short training: 20-minute recorded brief + 8-question quiz localized for EMEA/APAC. Require managers to watch/attest; managers then must confirm their teams discussed the policy in the next 1:1. Lina can we record two times for EMEA friendly hours?

Lina (HR-Intl): Yep. I'll record at 09:30 CET and 18:00 CET next Wed and upload both. Quiz created and set to auto-grade. Will add translations for FR/DE/ES core points.

Maya (People Ops): Manager checklist snippet I'm adding to the handbook (short):

```
Manager checklist:
- Collect supporting docs (email/itinerary/statement)
- Submit retro-pay form if applicable
- Complete handbook ack within 7 business days
- Mark team discussion complete in 1:1 notes
- Escalate exceptions to People Ops
```

Diego (Eng Manager): One edge case: contractor on short notice travel. Do we cover contractors or only employees?

Maya (People Ops): Draft currently covers employees only. I'll add a contractor FAQ section and a sample engagement note for Hiring Ops to use.

Priya (Hiring Ops): On it. I'll include contractor flag in the export and ping Eng-SRE for any infra to automate ack links.

Maya (People Ops): Great. Final action items: Lina finalize intl appendix by EOD, Priya run exports and schedule reminders, Diego send any recent edge cases by EOD. I'll publish the update after manager ack hits 60% for wave A and announce company-wide.

Diego (Eng Manager): Acknowledged 44d Ill DM the two recent cases now.
